## Tasks

### <a name="check_ca"></a>`check_ca`

Report the expiry of the CA certificate bundle, the CRLs, the server's own certificate, and the certificates the CA has issued, on the CA host. Read-only.

**Supports noop?** false

#### Parameters

##### `warn_days`

Data type: `Integer[0]`

Flag anything that expires within this many days.

##### `issued`

Data type: `Enum[due, all, none]`

Which issued certificates from the CA's signed directory to list: only those due within warn_days or already expired, all of them, or none. Counts for the whole directory are always returned.

##### `section`

Data type: `Enum[server, master, main]`

The puppet.conf section to resolve settings from.

### <a name="check_host_cert"></a>`check_host_cert`

Report the expiry of this host's certificate, its copy of the CA bundle, and its copy of the CRL. Read-only.

**Supports noop?** false

#### Parameters

##### `warn_days`

Data type: `Integer[0]`

Flag anything that expires within this many days.

### <a name="extend_ca"></a>`extend_ca`

Re-sign the CA certificate bundle in place with a new validity period, keeping keys, subjects, serials, and extensions. Uses `puppetserver ca extend` when the CA CLI has it, otherwise the module's own implementation. Run on the CA host while OpenVox Server is stopped. Backs up every file it replaces.

**Supports noop?** false

#### Parameters

##### `ttl`

Data type: `Pattern[/\A\d+[ydhms]?\z/]`

New lifetime for the CA certificate, in the CA gem's format: a number with an optional y, d, h, m, or s suffix.

##### `crls`

Data type: `Enum[expired, all, none]`

Which CRLs to re-sign: only expired ones, all of them, or none.

##### `dry_run`

Data type: `Boolean`

Compute and report the change without writing any file.

##### `force`

Data type: `Boolean`

Proceed even if puppetserver appears to be running.

##### `implementation`

Data type: `Enum[auto, gem, library]`

Which re-signing implementation to use: `auto` prefers `puppetserver ca extend` when the CA CLI has that subcommand and falls back to the module's own library, `gem` requires the subcommand, `library` never uses it.

##### `section`

Data type: `Enum[server, master, main]`

The puppet.conf section to resolve settings from.

### <a name="read_ca_bundle"></a>`read_ca_bundle`

Return the CA certificate bundle and CRL from the CA host, base64-encoded, for distribution to other hosts. Read-only.

**Supports noop?** false

#### Parameters

##### `section`

Data type: `Enum[server, master, main]`

The puppet.conf section to resolve settings from.

### <a name="refresh_puppetdb_ssl"></a>`refresh_puppetdb_ssl`

Refresh OpenVoxDB's copies of the CA certificate, host certificate, and key with `puppetdb ssl-setup -f`, when OpenVoxDB is installed on this host. Does not restart the service.

**Supports noop?** false

### <a name="regen_primary_cert"></a>`regen_primary_cert`

Replace the CA host's own certificate with one generated offline by `puppetserver ca generate --ca-client`, which carries the pp_cli_auth extension the CA CLI needs. Run while OpenVox Server is stopped. Backs up the files it removes.

**Supports noop?** false

#### Parameters

##### `dns_alt_names`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Subject alternative names to put on the new certificate. The old certificate's names are not carried over automatically.

##### `force`

Data type: `Boolean`

Proceed even if puppetserver appears to be running.

### <a name="remove_localcacert"></a>`remove_localcacert`

Move this host's copies of the CA bundle and CRL aside so the agent fetches fresh ones from the server, then optionally trigger a no-op agent run to do so right away. The agent downloads the CA bundle without needing a valid one, so this also works after the old copy has expired.

**Supports noop?** false

#### Parameters

##### `trigger_run`

Data type: `Boolean`

Run `puppet agent -t --noop` afterwards so the new bundle is fetched immediately.

### <a name="upload_ca"></a>`upload_ca`

Install a CA certificate bundle, and optionally a CRL, into this host's SSL directory, backing up the previous copies. Use when the host's old CA copy has expired and it can no longer fetch a new one itself.

**Supports noop?** false

#### Parameters

##### `bundle`

Data type: `String[1]`

The CA certificate bundle, PEM, base64-encoded.

##### `crl`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

The CRL, PEM, base64-encoded.

##### `restart_agent`

Data type: `Boolean`

Restart the puppet agent service afterwards so a long-running agent picks up the new bundle.

## Plans

### <a name="openvox_ca--check"></a>`openvox_ca::check`

Runs the CA check on the CA host and the host certificate check on every
other target, prints one line per certificate sorted by days left, and
returns the raw reports so another plan or a scheduled run can consume them.

The CA check also audits every certificate the CA has issued, from the
CA's signed directory, so the fleet's certificate expiry is visible from
the CA host alone without an inventory of agents. By default only the
issued certificates that are due or expired are listed; counts for the
whole directory are always printed. An expiring issued certificate does
not affect the CA's own status.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `openvox_ca::check` plan:

* [`ca`](#-openvox_ca--check--ca)
* [`targets`](#-openvox_ca--check--targets)
* [`warn_days`](#-openvox_ca--check--warn_days)
* [`issued`](#-openvox_ca--check--issued)

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--check--ca"></a>`ca`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

The CA host. Exactly one target.

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--check--targets"></a>`targets`

Data type: `Optional[TargetSpec]`

Other hosts to check. Optional.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--check--warn_days"></a>`warn_days`

Data type: `Integer[0]`

Flag anything that expires within this many days.

Default value: `90`

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--check--issued"></a>`issued`

Data type: `Enum[due, all, none]`

Which issued certificates to list: those due within warn_days or expired, all, or none.

Default value: `'due'`

### <a name="openvox_ca--distribute"></a>`openvox_ca::distribute`

Two strategies. `refetch` (the default) moves each host's copy of the CA
bundle and CRL aside and runs the agent once in no-op mode so it fetches
fresh copies from the server; agents fetch the bundle without needing a
valid one, so this works after the old copy has expired. `upload` reads the
bundle and CRL from the CA host and writes them to each target directly,
for hosts that cannot reach the server or should not run the agent.

On a healthy deployment neither is needed: agents refresh their CA bundle
from the server every `ca_refresh_interval` (one day by default).

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `openvox_ca::distribute` plan:

* [`ca`](#-openvox_ca--distribute--ca)
* [`targets`](#-openvox_ca--distribute--targets)
* [`strategy`](#-openvox_ca--distribute--strategy)
* [`restart_agent`](#-openvox_ca--distribute--restart_agent)
* [`trigger_run`](#-openvox_ca--distribute--trigger_run)

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--distribute--ca"></a>`ca`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

The CA host. Exactly one target.

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--distribute--targets"></a>`targets`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

The hosts to update.

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--distribute--strategy"></a>`strategy`

Data type: `Enum[refetch, upload]`

`refetch` or `upload`.

Default value: `'refetch'`

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--distribute--restart_agent"></a>`restart_agent`

Data type: `Boolean`

With `upload`, restart the puppet agent service afterwards.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--distribute--trigger_run"></a>`trigger_run`

Data type: `Boolean`

With `refetch`, run the agent once in no-op mode right away.

Default value: `true`

### <a name="openvox_ca--extend"></a>`openvox_ca::extend`

Stops OpenVox Server, re-signs the CA bundle with the same keys and a new
validity period, refreshes OpenVoxDB's copies if it runs on the same host,
starts everything again, and prints the expiry before and after. Every file
the plan replaces is backed up next to the original first.

Agents keep working with their old copy of the CA certificate until it
expires, because the signing key has not changed. Distribute the new bundle
before that happens.

The re-signing itself is done by `puppetserver ca extend` when the CA CLI on
the host has that subcommand, and by the module's own implementation
otherwise. Pass `implementation` to force one or the other.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `openvox_ca::extend` plan:

* [`ca`](#-openvox_ca--extend--ca)
* [`ttl`](#-openvox_ca--extend--ttl)
* [`implementation`](#-openvox_ca--extend--implementation)
* [`crls`](#-openvox_ca--extend--crls)
* [`regen_primary_cert`](#-openvox_ca--extend--regen_primary_cert)
* [`dns_alt_names`](#-openvox_ca--extend--dns_alt_names)
* [`restart_puppetdb`](#-openvox_ca--extend--restart_puppetdb)
* [`dry_run`](#-openvox_ca--extend--dry_run)
* [`force`](#-openvox_ca--extend--force)
* [`warn_days`](#-openvox_ca--extend--warn_days)

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--extend--ca"></a>`ca`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

The CA host. Exactly one target.

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--extend--ttl"></a>`ttl`

Data type: `Pattern[/\A\d+[ydhms]?\z/]`

New lifetime for the CA certificate, in the CA gem's format.

Default value: `'15y'`

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--extend--implementation"></a>`implementation`

Data type: `Enum[auto, gem, library]`

`auto` prefers `puppetserver ca extend` when present, `gem` requires it, `library` never uses it.

Default value: `'auto'`

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--extend--crls"></a>`crls`

Data type: `Enum[expired, all, none]`

Which CRLs to re-sign: only expired ones, all, or none.

Default value: `'expired'`

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--extend--regen_primary_cert"></a>`regen_primary_cert`

Data type: `Boolean`

Also replace the CA host's own certificate, for when it has expired too.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--extend--dns_alt_names"></a>`dns_alt_names`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Subject alternative names for the regenerated host certificate.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--extend--restart_puppetdb"></a>`restart_puppetdb`

Data type: `Boolean`

Refresh and restart OpenVoxDB if it is installed on the CA host.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--extend--dry_run"></a>`dry_run`

Data type: `Boolean`

Report what would change without stopping anything or writing any file.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--extend--force"></a>`force`

Data type: `Boolean`

Extend even when nothing is due to expire within warn_days.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-openvox_ca--extend--warn_days"></a>`warn_days`

Data type: `Integer[0]`

The window used to decide whether anything is due.

Default value: `90`
